subject: financial_literacy
concept: Setting a simple savings goal with a specific amount and reason
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student picks a real or illustrative item, notes its price, and sets a savings goal for it
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a savings goal to a jar/chart showing how much has been saved so far
exercise.abstract: Student states a specific savings goal, including the amount needed and why they want it

misconception_flags: sets a vague goal with no specific amount attached

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
